document_title: Process Characterization Master Plan — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
out_of_schema_notes: The master plan spans the whole train: entities are the Step 3-10 process steps, the CQA register, every parameter of the train with the class its report assigned and the NOR in force, the instrumented scale-down systems and the method validations of the package. Each NOR a Version 2.0 report narrowed is a report statement anchored on its footnote of the parameter table.

acceptance_criteria holds one in-force Version 2.0 record per row of the intermediate acceptance criteria table (the plan prints no criteria-change table), plus the one Version 1.0 limit the plan states, the cation exchange aggregate limit, as superseded. The in-force records that verification moved carry a value with an A-Mab confidence bound in it; their a priori values are stated in prose and were never in force, so they have no record.

Studies are every chronology row of a schema study type. Hold studies, the method comparability study S-CEX-FRC, the nrCE-SDS retests and the invalidated first anion exchange execution S-AEX-SUP have no StudyDesign.study_type and are left out. The supplementary qualification study S-PA-SDM2 is a discrepancy from PCP-005 that PCR-005 records, not a deviation, and the schema has no record for a plan discrepancy; it is a report statement.
Each instrumented system is anchored on the first row of its group in the calibration table, which names it; the rows below continue its merged cells.
The campaign thresholds for model adequacy and capability, the decision statistics, the verification rule and the classification rules have no schema field; they are report_sections statements.
The size-variant methods table anchors the SEC (AMV-3011) and nrCE-SDS (AMV-3020) method records on the rows that name each method and occur once in the document.
No rhetorical_spans: the Version 1.0 annex carried none for the master plan, and none were curated for Version 2.0. weak_claims is empty.

Studies of the Version 2.0 re-analysis that the master plan does not list, because each step report records its own as a discrepancy from its plan: S-BRX-OSM, S-HAR-UNI2, S-UFDF-UNI2, S-VI-UNI2. They have no record here.

statements.statement_text: PCMP-001 governs the Stage 1 process characterization of the A-Mab drug substance process, under the Process Transfer Plan PTP-001.

source_references.quote: This plan governs the Stage 1 process characterization of the A-Mab drug substance process.

statements.statement_text: Each step plan, PCP-003 to PCP-010, applies the master plan to one step and should state any departure from it with the reason.

source_references.quote: Each Process Characterization Plan (PCP-003 to PCP-010) applies this framework to one step.

statements.statement_text: Version 1.0 of the master plan defined no criteria for step outputs; Version 2.0 is issued under INV-001.

source_references.quote: Version 1.0 of this plan defined no criteria for step outputs.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 defines intermediate acceptance criteria for the step outputs by a rule that uses no data from the studies it judges.

source_references.quote: The rule that derives them uses no data from the studies it judges.

statements.statement_text: The intermediate acceptance criteria replace the Version 1.0 step criteria, the corrective action for INV-001 findings 1 and 2.

source_references.quote: They replace the Version 1.0 step criteria described above (INV-001 findings 1 and 2).

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 qualifies each scale-down model by its offset from manufacturing scale, not by a test of equivalence, and states every judgement against a criterion at manufacturing scale.

source_references.quote: It qualifies each scale-down model by its offset from manufacturing scale, not by a test of equivalence, and states every judgement against a criterion at manufacturing scale

statements.statement_text: Version 1.0 judged the cation exchange pool against an aggregate limit of 1 % HMW; Version 2.0 credits no later step with aggregate removal, so the a priori criterion of the pool is the drug substance criterion, 5 %.

source_references.quote: The a priori criterion of the cation exchange pool is therefore the drug substance criterion itself, 5 %.

statements.statement_text: Verification found that UF/DF raises aggregate within its NOR, and the cation exchange pool criterion in force carries that increase, 4.90 %.

source_references.quote: Verification then found that UF/DF raises aggregate within its NOR, and the criterion in force carries that increase. It is 4.90 %

statements.statement_text: A scale-down model is qualified for each output by the offset between the scales, and every judgement of a scale-down result against a criterion first subtracts that offset.

source_references.quote: It is qualified by the offset between the scales, not by a test of equivalence.

statements.statement_text: S-PA-SDM2 ran after the Version 1.0 reports were approved, to narrow the confidence interval of the offset for host cell protein in the Protein A pool; PCR-005 records it as discrepancy PD-005-01 from PCP-005, not as a deviation.

source_references.quote: They are work that the Protein A plan PCP-005 did not foresee, and the Protein A report PCR-005 records them as discrepancy PD-005-01 from that plan.

statements.statement_text: From 2026-03-20 (AMD-001), every study that measures fragments, at every step, measures them by nrCE-SDS (AMV-3020).

source_references.quote: From 2026-03-20, every study that measures fragments, at every step, measures them by nrCE-SDS (AMV-3020, under SOP-3015).

statements.statement_text: The screening model identifies effects, and the response-surface model is the predictive model from which every prediction, PAR and design space in the package comes.

source_references.section_title: Models, and what each model is for
heading_path: Models, and what each model is for
source_references.quote: Every prediction, every PAR and every design space in the package comes from it.

statements.statement_text: No report should claim prediction from a screening model.

source_references.section_title: Models, and what each model is for
heading_path: Models, and what each model is for
source_references.quote: No report should claim prediction from a screening model.

statements.statement_text: For a quality attribute the NOR-propagated analysis compares the 95 % prediction interval of a single batch with the criterion.

source_references.quote: For a quality attribute it compares the 95 % prediction interval of a single batch, because a single batch is what must meet the criterion.

statements.statement_text: For viral clearance the NOR-propagated analysis compares the worst case within the NOR: the lowest mean predicted log reduction over every combination of NOR low, set-point and NOR high of the other factors must meet the claim of the step.

source_references.quote: For viral clearance it compares the worst case within the NOR.

statements.statement_text: The NOR-propagated PAR is the one that supports a claim.

source_references.quote: The NOR-propagated PAR is the one that supports a claim.

statements.statement_text: A PAR that reaches the edge of the characterized range is reported as reaching it, and no claim is made beyond it.

source_references.quote: A PAR that reaches the edge of the characterized range is reported as reaching it, and no claim is made beyond it.

statements.statement_text: Each drug substance criterion is carried backward through the train using the platform worst case of each downstream step, with no margin applied.

source_references.quote: Each drug substance criterion is carried backward through the train, step by step, using the worst case that each downstream step showed on the platform.

statements.statement_text: For host cell protein the Protein A pool criterion is 16,719 ng/mg, widened from 16,000 ng/mg a priori by the anion exchange bound, and the cation exchange pool criterion is widened to 418 ng/mg.

source_references.quote: The Protein A pool criterion is therefore 16,719 ng/mg, and the cation exchange pool criterion is widened to 418 ng/mg.

statements.statement_text: Of the 22 intermediate acceptance criteria, 17 are in force at their a priori value and verification changed 5.

source_references.quote: 17 are in force at their a priori value and verification changed 5.

statements.statement_text: Verification may change a criterion in either direction: an A-Mab worst case worse than the platform tightens it, and a better one-sided 95 % prediction bound of a single batch from an adequate model widens it.

source_references.section_title: Verification of the platform worst cases
heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: Verification may change a criterion in either direction, by the following rule.

statements.statement_text: In both directions the prediction bound of a single batch, on its unfavourable side, replaces the platform value, and the point prediction never does.

heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: In both directions the bound, on its unfavourable side, replaces the platform value, and the point prediction never does.

statements.statement_text: Of the 9 platform worst cases the criteria assume, 7 can be checked against the response-surface designs of low-pH viral inactivation, cation exchange and anion exchange.

source_references.section_title: Verification of the platform worst cases
heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: Of the platform worst cases, 7 are responses of the response-surface designs of low-pH viral inactivation, cation exchange and anion exchange, and they can be checked.

statements.statement_text: The assumption that UF/DF does not change aggregate is checked on the univariate study of UF/DF, which varied number of diavolumes, transmembrane pressure and final DS concentration.

heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: Its assumption is checked on the univariate study of UF/DF made during the Version 2.0 re-analysis, which varied number of diavolumes, transmembrane pressure and final DS concentration.

statements.statement_text: The prediction bound of a single batch replaced the platform value for the aggregate increase of low-pH viral inactivation and the host cell protein clearance of anion exchange.

heading_path: Verification of the platform worst cases
source_references.quote: The prediction bound of a single batch was better than the platform worst case for the aggregate increase of low-pH viral inactivation and the host cell protein clearance of anion exchange, and these bounds replaced the platform values.

statements.statement_text: For the acidic variants increase of low-pH viral inactivation the prediction bound of a single batch was also better, but the model does not meet the adequacy criteria, so the platform values stand.
